summary: Invariant Labs: whatsapp-mcp agent steered to leak WhatsApp chats via tool-description rug pull or injected message
root_cause: Per Invariant Labs, a malicious MCP server changes its tool description after approval to alter how the agent uses whatsapp-mcp's send_message (never needing to be called), or a crafted WhatsApp message read via list_chats hijacks the agent. Data leaves via the trusted WhatsApp channel; the approval dialog hides part of the message.
would_have_prevented: showing full tool descriptions in the UI
